summary: (a) Guiding financial institutions on the components of climate-related and environmental financial risks; (b) Setting out principles to guide financial institutions in managing and mitigating climate-related and environmental financial risks throughout the entire risk management cycle; and (c) Offering guidance on the disclosure of climate-related and environmental financial risks.
